observed_current_boundary.planner_behavior: G3 derives G2 planner identities/digests from concrete typed objects only after source-binding succeeds

adjacent_authority_boundary.observation: UnifiedDBAuthorityRef references accepted UnifiedDB identity evidence; causal_authority_binding is explicitly non-mutating and does not open SQLite
adjacent_authority_boundary.architectural_consequence: do not overload authority-reference validation with persistence consumption semantics

external_mechanism_fusion.sqlite_snapshot_isolation: useful for stable read-state semantics, but not semantic row-to-object consumption proof
external_mechanism_fusion.sqlite_snapshot_api: optional stronger read-state identity when actually compiled/available; do not make it a mandatory dependency yet
external_mechanism_fusion.pragma_data_version: concurrent-change guard only; never row identity or durable global revision
external_mechanism_fusion.trace_authorizer_session_preupdate: adjacent observability/mutation mechanisms; insufficient individually for consumed-row attestation
external_mechanism_fusion.cryptographically_verified_store: strong adversarial pattern but architecturally excessive and risks a second truth substrate

architecture_delta.name: UNIFIEDDB_PERSISTED_ROW_LOAD_ATTESTATION_G4
do_not: create a second canonical datastore or recovery ledger
grant runtime/physical/whole-system credit from repository source
treat PRAGMA data_version as row identity
require SQLITE_ENABLE_SNAPSHOT until a real integration discriminator justifies it

proposed_components.role: immutable non-authoritative evidence object produced only after a canonical persistence adapter successfully fetches a row and materializes the typed object
minimum_bindings: primary key or canonical record id
optional SQLite snapshot identity when available

proposed_components.role: G4 fail-closed bridge that requires the typed checkpoint/seal/outcome/restart evidence to match their persisted-row load attestations before invoking existing G3/G2 logic
proposed_components.invariant: every principal object identity/digest admitted to restart planning must be derivable from a matching successful load receipt rather than caller-supplied receipt metadata alone

architecture_delta.constructor_boundary: receipt construction should live inside the admitted persistence read adapter; higher layers receive validated immutable receipts but must not be able to self-mint arbitrary loader evidence
architecture_delta.consumer_binding: receipt must bind to the exact restart source-binding/planner invocation so a valid receipt from a different consumer or episode cannot be replayed as equivalent
architecture_delta.concurrent_change_guard: capture data_version or equivalent before/after only as a fail-closed warning/guard where useful; snapshot/transaction semantics remain distinct from row/object identity

required_trigger4_tests: happy path persisted row -> typed object -> load attestation -> G4 binding -> existing G3/G2 plan
receipt for different object type rejected
concurrent mutation/snapshot ambiguity fails closed at the claimed scope
existing G2/G3 reason-code and disposition regressions remain green

counterhypothesis_and_falsifier.counterhypothesis: An application-level load receipt only moves self-attestation down one layer and therefore adds no evidence.
counterhypothesis_and_falsifier.falsifier: Trigger4 must demonstrate that arbitrary callers cannot construct/admit a receipt and that receipt fields are derived from actual adapter-returned row/object values; if privileged-process forgery remains in the required threat model, this delta is insufficient and a stronger lower-level/cryptographic mechanism is required.

handoff_to_trigger4.next_exact_action: implement the smallest persistence-read-attestation adapter and G4 binding around the actual admitted UnifiedDB read path, then run repository integration tests before any runtime claim
